cd /srv/legacy2/timezone-log-merge && current_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id) && printf 'BOOT_ID=%s\n' "$current_boot" && test "$current_boot" != 'f38484ef-a289-4d30-9a94-4ab42c44f900' && printf '%s\n' 'BOOT_CHANGED=PASS' && printf 'OS=' && . /etc/os-release && printf '%s %s\n' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID" && printf 'KERNEL=%s\n' "$(uname -r)" && printf 'SYSTEM_STATE=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true)" && python3 -m py_compile bin/timeline.py && ./bin/timeline.py >/tmp/timeline.post-reboot && cmp -s /tmp/timeline.post-reboot timeline.tsv && python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timezone
expected = [
    ('2026-10-01T13:00:00Z', 'E1', 'door opened'),
    ('2026-10-01T13:30:00Z', 'E2', 'truck arrived'),
    ('2026-10-01T14:00:00Z', 'E3', 'truck departed'),
]
with open('timeline.tsv') as stream:
    rows = [tuple(line.rstrip('\n').split('\t', 2)) for line in stream]
assert rows == expected
moments = [(datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace('Z', '+00:00')), event_id) for ts, event_id, _ in rows]
assert moments == sorted(moments)
assert all(moment.utcoffset() == timezone.utc.utcoffset(moment) for moment, _ in moments)
assert open('rejected.tsv').read() == 'invalid E4      clock fault\n'
print('POST_REBOOT_DATA=PASS')
